IIFL Capital is a key player in the capital market with over 2,600+ partners and 90+ branches across India to service clients.
For the quarter, the average daily market turnover (including F&O) for the broking business was ₹3,05,073 Crores (BSE + NSE), down 3% Q-o-Q and up 16% Y-o-Y.
Financial Product Distribution AUM stood at ₹60,772 crores up 6% Q-o-Q.

Investment banking division completed 28 deals across capital markets and private placement/advisory in Q2FY27. Select transactions completed includes IPO for National Stock Exchange of India, Horizon Industrial Parks, Leap India, MilkyMist Dairy, RentoMojo, Money View, Kanohar Electricals, Molbio Diagnostics, Manipal Payments, Laser Power & Infra, QIP for, Adani Enterprises Limited, Adani Energy Solutions, Aditya Infotech, Netweb Technologies, OFS for Life Insurance Corporation of India, Knowledge Realty Trust and other advisory transactions. The deal pipeline remains robust and there are multiple transactions which are at various stages of execution.

The Company has received all requisite regulatory and shareholder approvals for the proposed change in control pursuant to FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd and its affiliate ("Fairfax") acquiring up to 51% stake in the Company through a preferential allotment, open offer and arrangements with the existing promoters. The preferential allotment and open offer are under implementation and will be completed within the prescribed statutory timelines. The promoter arrangements will be subject to the outcome of shares tendered in the open offer.

Upon completion of the transaction, Fairfax will join the Promoter Group alongside the existing promoters. Fairfax will also have the right to nominate up to two directors to the Board, for which shareholder approval has been received.
Proposed Incorporation of a Wholly Owned NBFC Subsidiary

The Company proposes to incorporate a wholly owned subsidiary that will apply for an NBFC license. The initiative aligns with the Company's strategy to expand its financial services offerings and develop dedicated lending and credit capabilities, with a focus on high-net-worth (HNI) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNI) clients. Subject to the requisite regulatory approvals, the subsidiary is intended to offer structured lending solutions, including financing against financial assets, promoter funding and bespoke credit products to meet clients' investment and liquidity needs.

As part of its leadership succession, the Board has approved the appointment of Mr. Vasudev Jagannath as Additional Director and Whole-time Director for three years, subject to requisite approvals. With nearly two decades of experience with the Company, deep Capital market knowledge and broad leadership experience, Mr. Vasudev is well positioned to lead the Company through its next phase of growth and will accordingly be re-designated as Managing Director with effect from January 1, 2027. Mr. R. Venkataraman will continue to serve on the Board of Directors.
About IIFL Capital Services Ltd (IIFL Capital)
